# No file specified.
! sngl run

# --lang without --platform is an error.
! sngl run --lang=js app.sngl

# --platform without --lang defaults to first supported language.
# (run executes, so just verify it doesn't error on flag parsing)
# This would actually try to run, so we test with a non-runner platform instead.
! sngl run --platform=none app.sngl

# Platform "none" does not support direct execution.
! sngl run --lang=js --platform=none app.sngl

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import app "sngl:app"

component main node {
    var count = 0
    button(text="+", @click { count += 1 })
    text(value="Count: {count}")
}

app.window {
    main
}
